Specifically, the Sender Partner Number for the SAP connection used by your outbound GEPEPU flows is not found in the Distribution Schema on the SAP side. This is confirmed by the following error in your OPA logs: "Sender Partner Number is NOT FOUND in Distribution Schema. It is required for IXXX sending to SAP. See transaction BD64 for details." This is why only certain flows are failing while others (such as those running through sapXXX04 and sapXXX58) continue to succeed. The Workato OPA agent itself is running normally. To resolve this, we recommend the following steps on the SAP side: 1. Open transaction BD64 in the SAP system connected to the failing connection (sapXXX03). 2. Verify that the Sender Partner Number used by Workato is present and active in the ALE Distribution Model for the relevant message types. 3. Check whether any recent transports, BD64 changes, or model view modifications were applied today, as these could have removed or deactivated the required entry. Once the BD64 configuration is restored on the SAP side, the affected flows should resume."
